name: omiSt
source:
Think university life is just about classes and cheap beer? Think again. As Ethan, you're landing in Newcastle ready for a fresh start with your gorgeous childhood friend Olivia. What you aren't ready for is the high-tech mystery surrounding your uncle, a sentient AI, and a lineup of stunning women who are about to complicate your life in the best and worst ways possible.

omiSt throws you into a narrative-driven Adult Visual Novel experience where relationships are everything... and nothing is quite what it seems. Who will capture your attention?

[From [url=https://omist.itch.io/omist]Itch.io[/url]]
